title: EU GDPR footer links to legal notice and data privacy statement
body: ## Feature request - [x] I confirm that this is a feature request rather than a question. #### What problem does this feature solve? Any company from the EU has to put a link to their "Data Privacy Statement" on every website/webpage they publish. Especially in Germany we have to also put a "Legal Notice" on all our websites. A footer should look like so: #### What does the proposed API look like? We add additional keys to the config for links ``` theme: { links: { en: { contact: "https://statusfy.co/support", support: "https://statusfy.co/support", home: "https://statusfy.co", privacy: "https://statusfy.co/data-privacy", legal: "https://statusfy.co/legal" }, es: { contact: "https://statusfy.co/es/support", support: "https://statusfy.co/es/support", home: "https://statusfy.co/es", privacy: "https://statusfy.co/es/data-privacy", legal: "https://statusfy.co/es/legal" } } }, ``` #### How should this be implemented in your opinion? Simply by adding the keys as allowed keys to the `Footer.vue` and adding translations to the translation files. #### Are you willing to work on this yourself?** Yes. Here is my PR: https://github.com/bazzite/statusfy/pull/357
